title: Total transition probability from a vertex
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a finite vertex set, with positive degree $D$. For every nonnegative integer $k$ and every vertex $u$, the sum over all vertices $v$ of the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $k$ neighbor indices, followed from $u$, ends at $v$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
